name: Garden hose

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 560 px wide (hero size); use about 0.25 next to a person

params.note: true = water drops come out of the nozzle

params.name: anim
params.note: spray = the water drops flow out of the nozzle (needs spray true)
